# Source: Gmail API Discovery Document

- Discovery URL: https://gmail.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1
- Reference docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest
- Google Developers site policies: https://developers.google.com/terms/site-policies
- License note: Google Developers documentation is generally CC BY 4.0 except as
  otherwise noted; code samples are generally Apache 2.0.
- Retrieved: 2026-05-14

## Included Files

- `gmail-v1-discovery.json`: machine-readable Gmail API v1 description,
  including drafts, messages, labels, profile, and OAuth scope metadata.

This file is useful for agents that need exact Gmail draft and message API
contracts while preserving Keystone's draft-only and approval-gated behavior.
